why: A fishing rod lies by the stream: cast it at the water, steer the hook under the fish with the arrows, and strike with E.

components.fishStepTicks: number: ticks the fish takes per step along the line, on the rod
components.roundTicks: number: ticks a fish stays on the line before it swims off, on the rod
components.catchReach: number: how many steps off the fish the hook may be and still land it, on the rod
